visual_markers: square clay and mud-brick fort with thick sand-colored walls
four cylindrical watchtowers, one at each corner
a large central tower with a crenellated top
a small heavy wooden door set into the main gate
open paved plaza surrounding the fort in central Riyadh

facts.text_ar: حصن مبني من الطين واللبن، له أربعة أبراج مراقبة وجدران سميكة قائمة على أساس من كتل حجرية، ويقع في وسط الرياض في الأحياء القديمة.
facts.text_en: A clay and mud-brick fort with four watchtowers and thick walls founded on stone blocks, standing in the old quarter at the center of Riyadh.

facts.text_ar: بُني الحصن حوالي عام 1865 على يد عبدالرحمن بن سليمان بن دبعان، في عهد محمد بن عبدالله بن رشيد.
facts.text_en: The fort was built around 1865 by Abdulrahman ibn Sulaiman ibn Dabaan, during the rule of Mohammed ibn Abdullah ibn Rasheed.

facts.text_ar: في 14 يناير 1902 تمكّن عبدالعزيز بن عبدالرحمن آل سعود من الاستيلاء على الحصن من حامية آل رشيد، في الحدث المعروف باستعادة الرياض.
facts.text_en: On 14 January 1902 Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud captured the fort from its Rashid garrison, in the event known as the recapture of Riyadh.

facts.text_ar: يقع الحصن ضمن منطقة قصر الحكم، التي تضم عددًا من أبرز المعالم التراثية في الرياض.
facts.text_en: The fort sits within the Qasr Al-Hukm District, which holds several of Riyadh's most significant heritage landmarks.

facts.text_ar: يقع القصر ضمن منطقة قصر الحكم وسط الرياض، وهي النواة التاريخية للمدينة التي تضم أبرز معالمها التراثية.
facts.text_en: The fort stands in the Qasr Al-Hukm District in central Riyadh, the city's historic core and home to its main heritage landmarks.

facts.text_ar: جدرانه من الطين واللبن قائمة على أساس حجري، وله أربعة أبراج أسطوانية في الأركان وبرج مركزي مرتفع.
facts.text_en: Its walls are of clay and mud brick on a stone foundation, with four cylindrical corner towers and a taller central tower.

description_ar: حصن طيني مربّع في قلب الرياض القديمة، بُني في منتصف القرن التاسع عشر وصار رمزًا وطنيًا بعد استعادة الملك عبدالعزيز للرياض عام 1902م، وهو اليوم متحف ضمن منطقة قصر الحكم.
description_en: A square mud-brick fort in the heart of old Riyadh, built in the mid-19th century and turned into a national symbol after King Abdulaziz's recapture of Riyadh in 1902; today it is a museum within the Qasr Al-Hukm District.
era_ar: منتصف القرن 13هـ / القرن 19م — الدولة السعودية الثانية وما تلاها
era_en: Mid-19th century CE — late Second Saudi State period onwards

visit_info.note_ar: متحف مفتوح للزوار في وسط الرياض ضمن منطقة قصر الحكم؛ الدخول عادةً مجاني مع مواعيد رسمية معلنة.
visit_info.note_en: An open museum in central Riyadh within the Qasr Al-Hukm District; entry is normally free with published official hours.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

visual_markers: massive free-standing red sandstone formation shaped like an elephant
a thick rock arm resembling a trunk reaching down to the ground
wide flat desert sand surrounding the base with no buildings nearby
deep horizontal erosion lines across the rock body
isolated silhouette against open sky, no vegetation

facts.text_ar: تكوين صخري طبيعي في العلا شمال غرب السعودية، يبلغ ارتفاعه 52 مترًا عند أعلى نقطة فيه.
facts.text_en: A natural rock formation in AlUla, north-western Saudi Arabia, measuring 52 metres at its highest point.

facts.text_ar: يتكوّن أساسًا من الحجر الرملي الذي تعرّض للتعرية على مدى ملايين السنين بفعل المطر والرياح والرمال حتى اتخذ شكل فيل.
facts.text_en: It is formed mainly of sandstone eroded over millions of years by rain, wind and sand until it took the shape of an elephant.

facts.text_ar: تكوّنت الصخور الرملية المحيطة بالعلا قبل نحو 540 إلى 485 مليون سنة، ثم ارتفعت قبل نحو 30 مليون سنة مع بداية انفتاح البحر الأحمر.
facts.text_en: The sandstones around AlUla formed roughly 540–485 million years ago and were uplifted about 30 million years ago as the Red Sea began to open.

facts.text_ar: يقع شرق موقع الحِجر الأثري، ويُعد أحد العجائب الجيولوجية في محافظة العلا.
facts.text_en: It lies east of the Hegra archaeological site and is considered one of AlUla Governorate's geological wonders.

facts.text_ar: صخرة طبيعية من الحجر الرملي بطول 52 مترًا نحتتها الرياح والأمطار على مدى ملايين السنين.
facts.text_en: A natural sandstone rock 52 m tall, carved by wind and rain over millions of years.

description_ar: تكوين صخري طبيعي من الحجر الرملي يبلغ ارتفاعه نحو 52 مترًا، نحتته الرياح والأمطار على مدى ملايين السنين حتى صار على هيئة فيل، وهو من أشهر معالم العلا.
description_en: A natural sandstone formation about 52 m high, sculpted by wind and rain over millions of years into the shape of an elephant, and one of AlUla's most recognisable landmarks.
era_ar: تكوين جيولوجي طبيعي
era_en: Natural geological formation

visit_info.note_ar: موقع مفتوح مع جلسات خارجية ومقاهٍ، والزيارة عند الغروب أو ليلًا هي الأشهر.
visit_info.note_en: An open site with outdoor seating and cafés; sunset and night visits are the most popular.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: Joy and fun await you in the largest entertainment center in Riyadh, Riyadh Boulevard, where endless fun destinations can be found in one place.

In addition to the luxury shopping places where you can obtain pieces from the finest stores of international brands to your closet, along with dishes that amaze your senses with flavors of local and international cuisine.
Riyadh Boulevard offers fun, joy, and enthusiasm for adults and children.

facts.text_ar: حافة العالم اسم يُطلق على جرف يبلغ ارتفاعه 1131 مترًا، ويقع على بعد نحو 100 كم من الرياض عند طرف سلسلة جبال طويق الممتدة 800 كم.
facts.text_en: Edge of the World is the name of the 1.131 m height cliff that lies some 100 km from Riyadh at the end of the 800 km extending Tuwaik Mountain range.

facts.text_ar: تُعد حافة العالم وجهة مثالية لمحبي تسلق الجبال والمشي الجبلي، مع إطلالات مذهلة من أعلى الجرف.
facts.text_en: Edge of the World is the perfect destination of mountain climbing and hiking lovers. Discover the breathtaking off-cliff spectacular views.

facts.text_ar: يقع قرب العيينة غربي الرياض، وهو إحدى قمم جبال طويق التي تمتد لمئات الكيلومترات في وسط الجزيرة العربية.
facts.text_en: It lies near Al-Uyaynah west of Riyadh and is one of the peaks of the Tuwaiq mountains, which run for hundreds of kilometres across central Arabia.

description_ar: جرف صخري ضمن سلسلة جبال طويق شمال غرب الرياض قرب العيينة، يطل على سهول واسعة وتظهر في طبقاته رواسب بحرية تعود لعشرات ملايين السنين.
description_en: A dramatic escarpment in the Tuwaiq mountain chain northwest of Riyadh near Al-Uyaynah, overlooking vast plains, its layers containing marine sediments tens of millions of years old.
era_ar: تكوين جيولوجي — رواسب العصر الجوراسي لهضبة نجد
era_en: Geological formation — Jurassic-era sediments of the Najd plateau

visit_info.note_ar: موقع طبيعي غير مأهول؛ الوصول يتطلب مركبة دفع رباعي عادةً، ويُنصح بالذهاب مع مرشد ونهارًا.
visit_info.note_en: An unserviced natural site; access usually requires a 4x4 vehicle, and going with a guide in daylight is advised.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_ar: من الأرض إلى القمر، ومن عصور ما قبل التاريخ إلى العصر الحديث، تأخذك أروقة المتحف الوطني السعودي في رحلة تتجاوز الزمان والمكان.
facts.text_en: From the Earth to the moon, and from the prehistoric ages to the modern ages, the hallways of the Saudi National Museum will take you on an adventure that transcends time and space.

facts.text_ar: تشاهد فيه شواهد فنية وتاريخية في قلب الرياض بحي المربع قرب قصر الملك عبدالعزيز.
facts.text_en: You will witness artistic and historical evidence in the heart of Riyadh in Al Murabba neighborhood near King Abdulaziz palace.

facts.text_ar: افتُتح المتحف عام 1419هـ على مساحة 17,000 م²، ويروي قصة 3,700 قطعة أثرية من تماثيل ومخطوطات ومنحوتات نادرة.
facts.text_en: The museum was opened in 1419H and spans across a distance of 17,000Km2 where it tells the story of 3,700 artifacts such as statues, scripts and unique sculptures.

facts.text_ar: بُني المتحف على مساحة 17 ألف م²، وافتُتح عام 1419هـ/1999م، وتشرف عليه وزارة الثقافة.
facts.text_en: The museum was built over 17,000 m², opened in 1419 AH / 1999 CE, and is supervised by the Ministry of Culture.

facts.text_ar: يحوي نحو 4,413 قطعة أثرية وتاريخية تمتد قيمتها لآلاف السنين.
facts.text_en: It holds some 4,413 archaeological and historical objects spanning thousands of years.

facts.text_ar: يقع ضمن مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي الذي أُنشئ على مساحة 440 ألف م² وافتُتح في 22 يناير 1999م احتفاءً بمرور مائة عام على دخول الملك عبدالعزيز الرياض.
facts.text_en: It sits within the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre, built over 440,000 m² and opened on 22 January 1999 to mark the centenary of King Abdulaziz's entry into Riyadh.

description_ar: المتحف الرسمي للمملكة، افتُتح عام 1419هـ/1999م ضمن مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي في حي المربع بالرياض، ويعرض تاريخ الجزيرة العربية من عصور ما قبل التاريخ حتى الدولة السعودية الحديثة.
description_en: The Kingdom's official museum, opened in 1999 within the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre in Riyadh's Al-Murabba district, presenting the history of the Arabian Peninsula from prehistory to the modern Saudi state.
era_ar: مؤسسة حديثة (1999م) تعرض مقتنيات تمتد لآلاف السنين
era_en: Modern institution (1999) displaying artefacts spanning millennia

visit_info.note_ar: متحف حكومي تشرف عليه وزارة الثقافة، ضمن مجمّع مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي.
visit_info.note_en: A government museum supervised by the Ministry of Culture, inside the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre complex.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: In the range of King Abdulaziz National Reserve, you will find the biggest natural meadow in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with an area of ​​​​140,000 km² and extended greenery within sight.
Discover the wonderful days you will spend in Rawdat Tinhat.
One kilometer southwest of the Palace of Government, Addoho Neighborhood is located in the heart of the capital, Riyadh.
It is the last old neighborhood to preserve its traditional Najdi architecture. The construction of Addoho goes back more than 200 years.

With its strategic location within the Palace of Government area, its narrow alleys and the details of its houses that reflect the way of life of the locals at the time, Addoho Neighborhood tells the story of a desert civilization whose buildings were surrounded by walls and palm trees

facts.text_ar: جدران قصر المربع التاريخي أشبه بنافذة على تاريخ الرياض الغني ومشهد من ذاكرتها القديمة.
facts.text_en: The walls of Al Murabba Historial Palace are like a window to the rich history of Riyadh and a scene from its ancient memory.

facts.text_ar: تفيض مساحة القصر البالغة 1680 م² بذكريات المكان والأحداث التاريخية التي شهدها وما صُنع على أرضه.
facts.text_en: The 1680 m2 of land occupied by the palace overflows with the memories of the place and the historical events it witnessed, along with the glory that was made on its land.

facts.text_ar: شُيّد بأمر الملك عبدالعزيز في أواخر عام 1355هـ/1937م ضمن مجموعة قصور وديوان خارج الرياض القديمة في منطقة المربع.
facts.text_en: It was built by order of King Abdulaziz in late 1355 AH / 1937 CE as part of a group of palaces and a court outside old Riyadh in the Al-Murabba area.

facts.text_ar: أصبح المربع مكان إقامة الملك عبدالعزيز وأسرته، وهو اليوم من العناصر التاريخية البارزة في مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي.
facts.text_en: Al-Murabba became the residence of King Abdulaziz and his family, and the palace is now a prominent historic element of the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre.

description_ar: قصر طيني شُيّد بأمر الملك عبدالعزيز في أواخر عام 1355هـ/1937م خارج أسوار الرياض القديمة، وكان مقر إقامته وديوانه، وهو اليوم أحد عناصر مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي.
description_en: A mud-brick palace built by order of King Abdulaziz in 1937 outside the walls of old Riyadh as his residence and court; today it is a key component of the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre.
era_ar: 1355هـ/1937م — عهد الملك عبدالعزيز
era_en: 1937 CE — reign of King Abdulaziz

visit_info.note_ar: جزء من مجمّع مركز الملك عبدالعزيز التاريخي ويمكن زيارته مع المتحف الوطني.
visit_info.note_en: Part of the King Abdulaziz Historical Centre complex and can be visited together with the National Museum.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: At a 30-km distance in the outskirts of Riyadh, on the South of the road leading to Al-Kharj, lies Heet Cave, a geological landmark about which many interesting stories have been told.
You are promised to see one of the most beautiful natural landmarks, which dates back to thousands of years.
Many exciting stories have been told about it, most notably that it was formed as a rocky cavity with a depth of 390 m inside a mountain after a celestial body struck the Earth.
Wadi Namar enables you to watch the roaming of ducks’ flocks and the spread of small fish in the Lake Dam.

Inspirational thoughts will flow to your mind as you walk along the park’s paths that extend over 2,000m, amidst the fresh air of nature, the rustle of palm trees, and the roar of the lake’s waterfalls.
The nature of the place integrates, allowing you to take pictures of the sunset or admire the starry sky at night, in a scene in which the reflected lights of the valley shine around.
The Abstract Art Gallery connects between the artist and the audience, as it hosts local art pioneers and provides a space to display their work.
Cultural and popular legacies appear on the walls of the exhibition, with their overlapping colors and artistic styles are evident in the art pieces.

The exhibition scenes allow you to immerse in plastic and abstract arts, as the pleasure increases while looking at the geometric angles and color textiles of the artworks, with the participation of a group of art connoisseurs in the exhibition.
Al Kharrarah National Park, located in the South of Al Muzahimiyah Governorate, West of Riyadh, is your spacious sanctuary to escape from the crowded city.
You can relax and sit amid nature, which is full of green landscapes, sand dunes, and a lake formed from rainfall.
Wild Sidr trees and annual plants also grow in the park. You will enjoy a serenity-filled family time.
The naturally-grassed Dirab Golf and Country Club is situated 45 km from the heart of Riyadh.
It is the first golf course with 18 holes extended over a grassy surface surrounded by amazing natural greenery and tree-lined fairways.
Escape games are amongst the most recent entertainment components in the capital, Riyadh. They are offered by Last Hour, the escape games centre, through its innovative rooms of thrilling adventures.

Naila Art Gallery provides a window to see the artistic world of beautiful paintings embodying various cultures that go beyond time and place to the colorful world of creativity and abstract art forms in the company of elite artists and critics.
You can live a unique adventure in the Escape The Room in Riyadh with your family or friends.
It includes four separate rooms, containing multiple puzzles, symbols, and codes which must be solved so that you and your group can leave the room before the specified time which is 60 minutes.
This is an adventure full of suspense and mystery, that requires mental and physical efforts, with lots of excitement and fun.
This gallery is truly an educational spot, and an artistic destination worth a visit to discover the art pieces hanging on its walls.
You will find artistic paintings that create unique styles by mixing words with drawings; it will fill you with amazement.
All of this and more is found in Riyadh, Prince Mohammed bin Saad bin Abdulaziz Road, Al Malqa.
A huge source of information and an amazing architectural masterpiece, King Fahad National Library is located on King Fahad road in Olaya district with an area of about 87,000 square meters.
Come and discover King Fahad National Library and all the exceptional content and services.
Al-Areen Equestrian Club offers many services for horse lovers including horse riding, training programs, educational programs, and horse shelter and care services in its stables.
KAFD is an iconic business and lifestyle destination with state-of-the-art physical and digital infrastructure.
An architectural marvel designed by more than 25 world-leading architectural firms, KAFD currently has 95 towers that are reshaping the skyline of Riyadh.
Al-Subaie Palace, located in Al-Shagra province in Riyadh, is one of the most significant historical palaces in Saudi Arabia.
Built in a stunning Andalusian-Islamic style, the palace sits in the southwestern corner of the Old Town, offering a magnificent view of the historic souks (markets).
This palace was once a resting place for King Abdul Aziz during his travels to and from Riyadh.
Discover the Al-Munikh Visitor Center in Al-Majma'ah, located in the southern part of the historic town.

Positioned on a strategically elevated site, this iconic watchtower provided the town's residents with unobstructed views in all directions, ensuring their safety and awareness of the surrounding areas.

facts.text_ar: وجهة ثقافية وسياحية مهمة تقع بجوار جبل النور الذي يحتضن غار حراء.
facts.text_en: A significant cultural and tourist attraction located next to Jabal Al-Nour, home of Hira Cave.

facts.text_ar: يروي الحي قصة نزول الوحي ويقدّم نظرة على الأهمية التاريخية للجبل والغار.
facts.text_en: It tells the story of the divine revelation and offers insights into the historical importance of the mountain and the cave.

facts.text_ar: يُثري حي حراء الثقافي تجربة الزوار الثقافية والتعليمية عبر مرافقه المتنوعة.
facts.text_en: Hira Cultural District enriches visitors' cultural and educational experiences through its diverse facilities.

facts.text_ar: تشمل مرافق حي حراء الثقافي: معرض الوحي، ومتحف القرآن الكريم، وطريق الصعود إلى الغار، والمكتبة الثقافية، ومركز الزوار، ومرافق تجارية، وحديقة حراء وغيرها.
facts.text_en: Hira Cultural District Facilities include: The Revelation Gallery Museum of the Holy Quran The way up to the cave The Cultural Library Visitor Center Commercial facilities Hira Garden and other facilities

facts.text_ar: يقع غار حراء على قمة جبل النور بمكة، وهو الغار الذي نزل فيه الوحي على النبي محمد ﷺ ونزلت فيه أول آيات القرآن.
facts.text_en: The Cave of Hira lies at the summit of Jabal Al-Nour in Makkah; it is where the Revelation came to the Prophet Muhammad and where the first verses of the Qur'an were revealed.

facts.text_ar: يتاح للزائر الصعود إلى غار حراء عبر طريق ممهد ينطلق من حي حراء الثقافي مع لوحات إرشادية وأماكن استراحة.
facts.text_en: Visitors can ascend to the Cave of Hira via a paved path starting from the Hira Cultural District, with signage and rest areas.

description_ar: وجهة ثقافية عند سفح جبل النور بمكة المكرمة، تروي قصة الوحي ومعرض القرآن الكريم، وتوفّر طريقًا ممهدًا للصعود إلى غار حراء.
description_en: A cultural destination at the foot of Jabal Al-Nour in Makkah, telling the story of the Revelation and housing a Qur'an exhibition, with a paved path for the ascent to the Cave of Hira.
era_ar: وجهة معاصرة ترتبط بموقع تاريخي إسلامي
era_en: A contemporary destination attached to an Islamic historical site

visit_info.note_ar: مفتوح للزوار مع مسارات صعود مجهزة بلوحات إرشادية وأماكن استراحة.
visit_info.note_en: Open to visitors, with an ascent route equipped with signage and rest points.
visit_info.best_season_ar: أكتوبر – مارس، والصعود مبكرًا أو مساءً
visit_info.best_season_en: October – March; ascend early morning or evening
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_ar: منذ فجر الحضارة والكعبة المشرفة في المسجد الحرام تحمل مكانة دينية عظيمة لما لها من دلالات مرتبطة بالخالق سبحانه.
facts.text_en: Since the dawn of civilization, the Kaaba of Al Masjed Al Haram has had great religious significance, owing to its religious connotations associated with the Creator.

facts.text_ar: يتوجه نحو ملياري مسلم إلى قبلة الكعبة التي تتعلق بها قلوبهم لأداء الصلوات الخمس كما أمر الله، ودعائه طلبًا للرحمة والعون والهداية.
facts.text_en: Two billion Muslims face the direction of Kaaba, to which their hearts are attached too, to perform the five daily prayers, as commanded by the Almighty, and supplicate Him for mercy, assistance and guidance.

facts.text_ar: يقصد ملايين المعتمرين والحجاج والمصلين مكة المكرمة لأداء هذه الشعائر والتنعّم بسكينة المكان.
facts.text_en: Millions of Umrah, Hajj and prayer performers head to Makkah to perform these religious rites and enjoy the serenity of the place.

facts.text_ar: تجدر الإشارة إلى أن زيارة المسجد الحرام في مكة المكرمة مقصورة على المسلمين.
facts.text_en: It is important to note that only Muslims may visit Al Masjed Al Haram in Makkah.

facts.text_ar: تُقدّر مساحة المسجد الحرام بعد انتهاء مشروعات التوسعة السعودية الثالثة بنحو 1,371,000 م²، ويستوعب نحو 1,700,000 مصلٍّ.
facts.text_en: After the Third Saudi Expansion the Grand Mosque covers about 1,371,000 m² and can accommodate roughly 1,700,000 worshippers.

facts.text_ar: التوسعة السعودية الثالثة هي الأكبر في تاريخ المسجد من حيث المساحة والطاقة الاستيعابية، وبدأت عام 2011م.
facts.text_en: The Third Saudi Expansion is the largest in the mosque's history in area and capacity, beginning in 2011.

description_ar: أقدس مساجد المسلمين وقبلتهم، يحيط بالكعبة المشرفة في مكة المكرمة، وقد توسّع عبر عهود متعاقبة حتى بلغت مساحته بعد التوسعة السعودية الثالثة نحو 1,371,000 م².
description_en: Islam's holiest mosque and the direction of prayer, surrounding the Kaaba in Makkah. Expanded across successive eras, its area after the Third Saudi Expansion reaches about 1,371,000 m².
era_ar: موقع مقدس منذ ما قبل الإسلام، وتوسعات متعاقبة حتى العصر السعودي
era_en: A sacred site since before Islam, with successive expansions into the Saudi era

visit_info.note_en: Entry is for Muslims; Umrah and prayer visits are organised through official Two Holy Mosques permits.

visit_info.best_season_en: Year-round; peak in Ramadan and the Hajj season

name_en: King Abdulaziz Complex for the Holy Kaaba Kiswa

facts.text_en: A specialized factory for preparing the Kiswa of the Holy Kaaba, where it is crafted from silk embroidered with gold-plated threads, forming Quranic verses that adorn the walls of the Sacred House.

facts.text_ar: عين زبيدة موقع أثري بديع التصميم الهندسي في مكة المكرمة، يعكس عناية كبيرة بالحجاج عبر التاريخ، إذ تُعد أقدم شبكة استُخدمت لتزويد الحجاج والمسافرين بالماء طوال 1200 عام.
facts.text_en: Ain Zubaidah is a great archeological site of wonderful geometric design in Makkah. It reflects great care for pilgrims throughout history, as it is the oldest network used for providing pilgrims and travelers with water for 1200 years.

facts.text_ar: وقف عام أمرت بإنشائه زبيدة بنت جعفر زوجة الخليفة هارون الرشيد في القرن الثاني للهجرة لسقاية أهالي مكة وحجاج بيت الله.
facts.text_en: A public endowment ordered by Zubaydah bint Ja'far, wife of Caliph Harun al-Rashid, in the 2nd century AH to water the people of Makkah and the pilgrims.

facts.text_ar: تمتد العين من وادي نعمان بجبال الكَرا قرب الطائف حتى مشعر عرفات بمكة، بطول نحو 30 كم.
facts.text_en: The channel runs from Wadi Na'man in the Kara mountains near Taif to Arafat in Makkah, a distance of about 30 km.

facts.text_ar: ترتبط العين بمسار درب زبيدة، أحد طرق الحج المدرجة على القائمة التمهيدية للتراث العالمي لدى اليونسكو منذ 2022م.
facts.text_en: The system is linked to the Darb Zubaydah pilgrimage route, on UNESCO's World Heritage Tentative List since 2022.
facts.source_name: UNESCO Tentative List — The Hajj Pilgrimage Routes: The Darb Zubaydah

description_ar: مشروع مائي وقفي أمرت بإنشائه زبيدة بنت جعفر زوجة الخليفة هارون الرشيد في القرن الثاني الهجري لسقاية أهل مكة وحجاج بيت الله، ويمتد نحو 30 كم من وادي نعمان حتى عرفات.
description_en: An endowed water system commissioned by Zubaydah bint Ja'far, wife of Caliph Harun al-Rashid, in the 2nd century AH to supply the people of Makkah and pilgrims; it runs about 30 km from Wadi Na'man to Arafat.

era_en: 2nd century AH / 8th–9th century CE — Abbasid era

visit_info.note_en: An archaeological water system; sections are visible near Arafat and Wadi Na'man under the Heritage Commission's oversight.

facts.text_en: Masjid Al-Taneem is one of the mosques of Makkah Al-Mukarramah that is located in the western part of the city of Makkah, about 7 km away from Masjid Al-Haram.
It gained its fame because it was built in the place where Aisha bint Abu Bakr performed Umrah during the Farewell Pilgrimage in the 9th year of Hijra.

Makkah embraces many mosques that represent Islamic historical landmarks, some of them are related to a story or an event during the era of the Messenger (PBUH), and one of them is Masjid Al-Jinn near the Al-Hajun neighbourhood.
The building of the mosque is characterized by Mamluk-style architecture.

name_en: Sheikh Abdul Aziz bin Baz Mosque

facts.text_en: Sheikh Abdulaziz bin Baz Mosque is one of the largest mosques in Makkah and is famous for its distinguished location and beneficial activities.
It is one of the largest mosques in Makkah. It was established at the beginning of Ramadan in the year 1423 AH.
In the historic Al Zaher Palace, once a royal household, the Makkah Museum holds exhibits telling the history of Makkah, the archaeology of Saudi, and the story of the rise of Islam.
The building is a masterpiece of Islamic art and architecture.

The ultimate destination for astronomy enthusiasts, the museum offers an interactive and enjoyable experience for all visitors to explore the beauty of the universe, the wonders of the solar system, and the mechanisms of timekeeping.
It also offers many unique activities suitable for all age groups.
The first private museum dedicated to showcasing the history and transcription of the Holy Qur’an in Makkah, located in the Hira Cultural District.
It offers visitors a distinguished collection of rare Qur’anic manuscripts and enhances their experience with the latest museum technologies.
It presents the story of the revelation from its very first light in the Cave of Hira, along with detailed aspects of the life of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
The museum features halls equipped with the latest audiovisual display technologies, offering visitors an interactive experience that enriches their knowledge of the Prophet’s biography.

name_en: International Exhibition and Museum of the Biography of the Prophet and Islamic Civilization

facts.text_en: Explore the life of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) throughout history, his noble qualities, his Sunnah, and his life with his wives and companions.
The museum presents it in a detailed, captivating storytelling style. The exhibition is located in the King Abdulaziz Endowment - Clock Tower.

On your visit to Yanbu, you must go to Yanbu Man-Made Lake (Yanbu Lake Park). It is one of the most beautiful public places in Yanbu, where you can enjoy picturesque nature and take a walk in the open air.

The Night Market was built over 500 years ago close to the seaport in Yanbu. It was started by sailors and fishermen of the Red Sea with whatever they would bring from their fishing trips, whether treasures of the sea or trade connections.

The Market stood all these years as a historical symbol, offering its value to visitors who come all year round, decorated by unchanging originality and an archaeological spark allowing it to be one of the best tourist destinations in the West of Saudi Arabia.
Heritage monuments remain in Yanbu Historic District, which witnessed many civilizations, peoples, tribes and tumultuous historical events.
The monuments are estimated to be about 2500 years old. Yanbu Historic District is located in Yanbu Al-Bahr, south of Yanbu, on an area estimated at 45,000 square meters.
It includes about 100 heritage buildings, including mosques and various traditional markets.
An outlet for artists, Al-Sayegh House of the Arts is an exceptional destination located in the historical region of Yanbu.
It is a house with a traditional trait in its architecture inspired by the coastal nature of the city.
It includes fine arts that take you to an atmosphere full of amazement without restraining you.
On the contrary, it allows your imagination to go wild and is a tourist destination for amateur artists and art lovers.
Enjoy a relaxing picnic among the rustle of trees and the fragrances of flowers in Al Fairouz Park.
If you want to go for a walk in the fresh air, meditation nd relaxation, or if you want to have fun with your children, Al Sumayri Public Park is your destination.
Yanbu has always been a station on the trade route, and the beauty of its beaches has been attracting tourists.
Marjan Island, overlooking the enchanting blue waters of the Arabian Gulf, was opened in 1991 and the green area covers an area of up to 53,000 square meters.
The Heritage Village in Dammam is the name of the place where you can meet the past of Saudi Arabia and the heritage of its regions, on an area that extends to 21,000 square meters.
Its beautiful architecture hides within it a rich history.
The Khobar Sea Front welcomes its visitors with water and greenery, where towering trees spread as far as the eye can see and art pieces are scattered throughout.

One of the water fountains takes the shape of a shell with a shiny pearl in the middle, symbolizing one of the most beautiful treasures of the Arabian Gulf, whose crashing waves soften the atmosphere.
Sultan bin Abdulaziz Science and Technology Center (SciTech) is located on Khobar Corniche, occupying an area of 21,700 square meters.
It was established in 2000 to be a global scientific center that helps researchers, students, and enthusiasts in the fields of science and technology.

facts.text_ar: مركز الملك عبدالعزيز الثقافي العالمي هو الوجهة السعودية الأبرز للفنون والإبداع والتبادل الثقافي العالمي.
facts.text_en: The King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture, is Saudi’s premier hub for arts, creativity, and global cultural exchange.

facts.text_ar: يقع في الظهران، وتضم هذه التحفة المعمارية متاحف عالمية المستوى ومعارض تفاعلية ومكتبة ضخمة ومسرحًا للفنون الأدائية ومساحات تعليمية ملهمة.
facts.text_en: Located in Dhahran, this architectural masterpiece features world-class museums, interactive exhibitions, a vast library, a performing arts theater, and inspiring learning spaces.

facts.text_ar: بوصفه وجهة ثقافية رائدة، يستضيف إثراء فعاليات دولية مثل أيام الثقافة اليابانية والعروض الفنية العالمية والمهرجانات المحفّزة للتفكير التي تربط السعودية بالعالم.
facts.text_en: As a leading cultural destination, Ithra hosts international events such as Japan Cultural Days, global art showcases, and thought-provoking festivals that connect Saudi with the world.

facts.text_ar: من العروض الحيّة والتعاونات الفنية إلى ورش العلوم والأدب والتاريخ، يقدّم إثراء تجربة غامرة يزدهر فيها الإبداع والمعرفة.
facts.text_en: From live performances and artistic collaborations to science, literature, and history workshops, Ithra offers an immersive experience where creativity and knowledge thrive.

facts.text_ar: مركز ثقافي عالمي يقع في مدينة الظهران بالمنطقة الشرقية من المملكة.
facts.text_en: A global cultural centre located in Dhahran in the Kingdom's Eastern Province.

facts.text_ar: صُنّف ضمن أعظم مئة موقع في العالم عام 2018م، ويستقبل نحو مليون زائر سنويًا.
facts.text_en: It was classified among the world's 100 greatest places in 2018 and receives roughly one million visitors annually.

description_ar: مركز ثقافي عالمي في الظهران بالمنطقة الشرقية يضم متحفًا ومكتبة ومسرحًا وسينما ومركزًا للأفكار، صُنّف ضمن أعظم 100 موقع في العالم عام 2018م ويستقبل نحو مليون زائر سنويًا.
description_en: A global cultural centre in Dhahran, Eastern Province, housing a museum, library, theatre, cinema and idea lab. It was named among the world's 100 greatest places in 2018 and receives around one million visitors a year.
era_ar: عمارة معاصرة (افتُتح 2018م)
era_en: Contemporary architecture (opened 2018)

visit_info.note_en: Published opening hours and a rotating programme; some exhibitions are separately ticketed.

facts.text_en: Enjoy Taif’s rocky terrain and its pure fresh air in Arruddaf Park. The park spans over 500m2 of land covered in nature's most vibrant colors.
You can bask in the beauty of the cirrus clouds as they float over the marvelous greenery and highlands of the park.
You can also enjoy the beautiful sounds of nature or the live musical shows accompanied by interactive water fountains.

At the top of Al-Shafa Mountain over 2500 m. above sea level, you will enjoy the natural stunning scenery of the white fog embracing the tall Sarawat Mountain peaks with its emitting aroma of juniper trees.

You can take beautiful shots of the warm sun setting down the mountains overlooking the Tohama plains, the fertile valleys, and the green fields of pomegranate, grape, and fig trees.The distance between Al-Shafa Mountains and Al-Taif is about 30 km by car through Okba Al-Mohammadia Road which connects Al-Taif to Makkah.
You must return from your trip to Taif loaded with the fragrance of roses, whether with the pictures you took to enjoy their beauty or by buying their distinguished products.
One of the most beautiful exceptional experiences that you will have is a visit to the famous factories of Taif rose products to embark on a rich and unparalleled journey of exploration.

facts.text_ar: فوهة الوعبة أكبر وأعمق فوهة بركانية في المملكة العربية السعودية، يبلغ قطرها 3,000 متر، وتحيط بها جبال اللحيان وأم ريلان وزبنة مكوّنة مشهدًا يجسّد عجائب الطبيعة في السعودية.
facts.text_en: Wahba Crater is the largest and deepest volcanic crater in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with a diameter of 3,000 meters, and surrounded by Al Luhayan, Umm Rilan, and Zabna mountains forming a scenic view that embodies the wonders of nature in Saudi Arabia.

facts.text_ar: يبلغ عمق الفوهة نحو 380 مترًا، وتستقطب الجيولوجيين لاستكشاف أسرارها ورصد تكويناتها الصخرية المتنوعة والفريدة.
facts.text_en: The Crater, which is about 380 meters deep, attracts geologists to explore its secrets and observe its diverse and exotic rock formations.

facts.text_ar: تنتشر بين سكان القرى المجاورة حكايات وأساطير متوارثة حول نشأة الفوهة.
facts.text_en: Traditional legends are known and spread among residents of nearby villages around the Crater formation.

facts.text_ar: تقع شرق الطائف، وتُعرف أيضًا بـ«مقلع طميّة»، وتنتشر على حوافها ينابيع معدنية.
facts.text_en: It lies east of Taif, is also known as 'Maqla' Tamiyyah', and has mineral springs along its edges.

description_ar: فوهة بركانية عميقة شرق الطائف تُعرف أيضًا بمقلع طميّة، يبلغ قطرها نحو كيلومترين، وتنتشر على حوافها ينابيع معدنية وتغطي قاعها طبقة بيضاء من فوسفات الصوديوم.
description_en: A deep volcanic crater east of Taif, also known as Maqla' Tamiyyah, roughly two kilometres across, with mineral springs along its rim and a white sodium-phosphate crust on its floor.
era_ar: تكوين بركاني ضمن حرّات غرب الجزيرة العربية
era_en: A volcanic formation within the lava fields of western Arabia

visit_info.note_ar: موقع طبيعي نائي؛ يتطلب الوصول قيادة طويلة، والنزول إلى القاع يحتاج لياقة ووقت.
visit_info.note_en: A remote natural site requiring a long drive; descending to the floor needs fitness and time.

facts.text_en: In the historical area of ​​Taif, the exquisite architectural artistry of Al-Kaaki Palace combined juniper wood, granite stone, and colored glass to form and build the palace in the ancient Roman style, blended the spirit of the Hijaz community presented in the design of the palace windows and in the Hijazi decorations extending to the roof, forming an architectural masterpiece located on Al-Salama street.
It is time to discover the majestic Al-Hada Mountain, one of the most famous mountains in Saudi Arabia.
Al-Hada Mountain is one of Al-Sarawat Mountains range extending in a curved line of about 87 km between the two cities of Taif and Makkah.
You will certainly notice the gradual drop in temperature on your journey on Al-Hada Road.
Discover the charm of Taif's Earus Almasayif Museum, a top destination for those seeking to immerse themselves in the rich cultural and historical heritage of the region.
Wander through its beautifully curated rooms to admire fascinating artifacts, traditional crafts, and ancient architectur, all within a uniquely preserved heritage setting.

name_en: The Historical Palace of the Emirate

facts.text_en: The Aba Al-Saud neighborhood (Al-Balad) in the city of Najran embraces an important national heritage site that catches the eye of visitors immediately.

Upon arriving at the old heritage market, you will see the historic Emirate Palace in all its splendor and grandeur, providing an idea of the architectural fabric of the mud houses in Najran, and serving as an inspiring cultural framework for visitors and tourists, and a bridge of communication between generations.

facts.text_ar: تقع مدينة الأخدود التاريخية جنوب غرب نجران، ويمتد ماضيها إلى العصور القديمة.
facts.text_en: The historic city of Al-Okhdood is located southwest of Najran, with a past that dates back to ancient times.

facts.text_ar: شهدت المدينة حقبًا تاريخية تمتد إلى 1000 قبل الميلاد، ويكشف تاريخها عن حضارات إنسانية عبر فترات تاريخية مختلفة.
facts.text_en: It witnessed periods of history that extend to 1000 BC, and its history reveals human civilizations over different historical periods.

facts.text_ar: مدينة أثرية ووجهة سياحية تقع في منطقة نجران جنوب غرب المملكة العربية السعودية.
facts.text_en: An archaeological city and tourism destination in the Najran region of south-western Saudi Arabia.

facts.text_ar: جهّزت هيئة التراث التابعة لوزارة الثقافة مركز زوار في موقع الأخدود الأثري.
facts.text_en: The Heritage Commission of the Ministry of Culture has equipped a visitor centre at the Al-Ukhdud archaeological site.

description_ar: مدينة أثرية في منطقة نجران، من أقدم مراكز الاستيطان في جنوب الجزيرة العربية وارتبطت بأحداث تاريخية ذكرها القرآن الكريم، وتضم أساسات حجرية ونقوشًا قديمة ومركز زوار مجهزًا من هيئة التراث.
description_en: An archaeological city in the Najran region, among the oldest settlement centres of southern Arabia and associated with events mentioned in the Qur'an. It preserves stone foundations and ancient inscriptions, with a visitor centre equipped by the Heritage Commission.
era_ar: ما قبل الإسلام — جنوب الجزيرة العربية القديم
era_en: Pre-Islamic — ancient southern Arabia

visit_info.note_ar: موقع أثري مفتوح مع مركز زوار جهّزته هيئة التراث.
visit_info.note_en: An open archaeological site with a visitor centre equipped by the Heritage Commission.

visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: King Fahd Park is located in the Saqam Forest and is one of the most important natural recreational landmarks in the city and its largest park.
The park is characterized by its stunning natural scenery and breathtaking views, and it offers a range of enjoyable activities suitable for all family members.

facts.text_ar: تزدان نجران بقصور مهيبة شكّلت إرثًا تاريخيًا للمنطقة، ومنها قصر الآن التاريخي المعروف أيضًا بقصر سعدان.
facts.text_en: Najran is adorned with many majestic palaces that have formed a historical legacy for the region, including the historic Al-Aan Palace, also known as Saadan Palace.

facts.text_ar: يقع القصر على جبل الآن الذي يستمد منه اسمه، وقد بُني عام 1100هـ (1688/1689م)، وخضع لعدة ترميمات كان آخرها عام 1440هـ (2018/2019م).
facts.text_en: The palace is located on Al-Aan Mountain, from which it takes its name. It was built in 1100 AH (1689/1688 CE), and has undergone several renovations, the latest of which was in 1440 AH (2019/2018 CE).

facts.text_ar: يُدرج قصر العان ضمن القصور السعودية التاريخية البارزة.
facts.text_en: Al-Aan Palace is listed among Saudi Arabia's prominent historic palaces.

description_ar: قصر طيني تاريخي يقف على قمة جبل في نجران ويطل على وادي نجران والنخيل، وهو من القصور التاريخية البارزة في المملكة.
description_en: A historic mud-brick palace crowning a hilltop in Najran with views over the valley and its palm groves, counted among the Kingdom's notable historic palaces.
era_ar: عمارة نجرانية طينية تقليدية
era_en: Traditional Najrani mud-brick architecture

visit_info.note_ar: موقع تراثي مطل يُزار مع معالم نجران التاريخية.
visit_info.note_en: A hilltop heritage site visited alongside Najran's other historic landmarks.
