facts.text_ar: اكتشف قصر القشلة في حائل، الموقع التراثي الأيقوني الذي يجسّد الطراز المعماري النجدي التقليدي.
facts.text_en: Discover Al-Qashla Castle in Hail, an iconic heritage site that showcases the traditional Najdi architectural style.

facts.text_ar: بُني في عهد الملك عبدالعزيز عام 1360هـ (1941م)، ويقف رمزًا للتراث العمراني الغني في حائل.
facts.text_en: Built during the reign of King Abdul Aziz in 1360 AH (1941 CE), Al-Qashla stands as a symbol of Hail’s rich urban heritage.

facts.text_ar: شُيّد من الطين والحجارة، ويتميز بزخارف جصية دقيقة بأشكال هندسية ونباتية معتادة في العمارة التقليدية بالمنطقة.
facts.text_en: Constructed from clay and stones, the castle features intricate plaster decorations with geometric and floral motifs typical of traditional architecture in the region.

facts.text_ar: تؤكد أبراجه الدفاعية الأسطوانية التي يبلغ ارتفاعها 12 مترًا، ومنها أربعة أبراج داخلية تُسمى «السندة»، قوته الدفاعية.
facts.text_en: Its 12-meter-high cylindrical defensive towers, including four internal "Al-Sandah" towers, emphasize its defensive strength.

facts.text_ar: كان قلعة عسكرية استُخدمت لتجهيز الجيوش، ثم حُوّل إلى قصر عام 1360هـ/1941م في عهد الملك عبدالعزيز.
facts.text_en: It served as a military fort for equipping armies before being converted into a palace in 1360 AH / 1941 CE under King Abdulaziz.

facts.text_ar: تبلغ مساحته 19,832 م² بطول 142 م وعرض 141 م، وترتفع جدرانه إلى نحو 10 أمتار.
facts.text_en: It measures 19,832 m² — 142 m long by 141 m wide — with walls rising to about 10 metres.

description_ar: مبنى طيني ضخم وسط مدينة حائل، أُنشئ كقلعة عسكرية لتجهيز الجيوش ثم حُوّل إلى قصر عام 1360هـ/1941م في عهد الملك عبدالعزيز، وتبلغ مساحته نحو 19,832 م².
description_en: A vast mud-brick building in central Hail, originally a military barracks for equipping armies and converted into a palace in 1360 AH / 1941 CE under King Abdulaziz; it covers about 19,832 m².
era_ar: 1360هـ/1941م — عهد الملك عبدالعزيز
era_en: 1360 AH / 1941 CE — reign of King Abdulaziz

visit_info.note_en: A restored heritage site open to visitors in central Hail.

facts.text_ar: ارحل عبر الزمن في أم سنمان، الموقع المدرج في قائمة التراث العالمي لليونسكو منذ 2015م، وأحد أبرز مواقع الفنون الصخرية في السعودية.
facts.text_en: Journey through time at Umm Sinman, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2015, and one of Saudi's most prominent rock art locations.

facts.text_ar: يقع في شمال المملكة، وتزدان واجهات جبل أم سنمان الصخرية بنقوش بشرية وحيوانية من حقب تاريخية متعددة، أقدمها يعود إلى أكثر من 12,000 عام مع بداية العصر الحجري الحديث.
facts.text_en: Situated in the northern region of the Kingdom, the rock faces of Mount Umm Sinman are adorned with human and animal carvings from various historical eras, with the oldest dating back over 12,000 years to the beginning of the Neolithic era.

facts.text_ar: يضم الموقع كذلك نقوشًا ثمودية قديمة وكتابات إسلامية مبكرة، بعضها يعود إلى عام 147هـ.
facts.text_en: The site also includes ancient Thamudian inscriptions and early Islamic writings, with some inscriptions dating back to 147 AH.

facts.text_ar: تقدّم هذه النقوش المدهشة لمحة عن الثراء الثقافي والتاريخ العميق للاستيطان البشري في جُبّة عبر آلاف السنين.
facts.text_en: These remarkable carvings offer a glimpse into the cultural richness and deep history of human settlement in Jubbah, capturing the essence of ancient life across millennia.

facts.text_ar: أُدرج الموقع في قائمة التراث العالمي عام 2015م وفق المعيارين (i) و(iii).
facts.text_en: The property was inscribed on the World Heritage List in 2015 under criteria (i) and (iii).
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rock Art in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia

facts.text_ar: يقع جبل أم سنمان بجُبّة على بعد نحو 90 كم شمال غرب مدينة حائل، وكان المشهد المحيط به يطل على بحيرة عذبة.
facts.text_en: Jabal Umm Sinman at Jubbah lies about 90 km north-west of Hail, in a landscape that once overlooked a freshwater lake.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rock Art in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia

facts.text_ar: تُوثَّق الكتابة الثمودية، التي يُرجَّح ظهورها قبل نحو 3000 سنة، في آلاف النقوش بجُبّة.
facts.text_en: Thamudic writing, probably introduced about 3,000 years ago, is documented in thousands of inscriptions at Jubbah.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rock Art in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia

facts.text_ar: يشكّل الموقع مع جبل المنجور ورَاط بالشويمس أكبر وأغنى مجمّعات الفنون الصخرية في المملكة والمنطقة.
facts.text_en: Together with Jabal al-Manjor and Raat at Shuwaymis, it forms the biggest and richest rock-art complex in the Kingdom and the wider region.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rock Art in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia

description_ar: أحد مكوّني موقع «الفنون الصخرية في منطقة حائل» المسجّل في التراث العالمي عام 2015م، ويقع على بعد نحو 90 كم شمال غرب حائل، ويضم آلاف النقوش واللوحات الصخرية في منظر كان يطل على بحيرة عذبة.
description_en: One of the two components of 'Rock Art in the Hail Region', inscribed in 2015. About 90 km north-west of Hail, it holds thousands of petroglyph panels and inscriptions in a landscape that once overlooked a freshwater lake.
era_ar: عصور ما قبل التاريخ حتى نحو 3000 سنة مضت (النقوش الثمودية)
era_en: Prehistory to roughly 3,000 years ago (Thamudic inscriptions)

facts.text_en: Discover Turan Village, located 55 kilometers from Hail. Known as the land of the legendary Arab figure Hatim Al-Ta’i, Turan celebrates the enduring legacy of his unmatched generosity, immortalized in Arab culture with the phrase, "More generous than Hatim." Today, the village preserves remnants of its storied past, including a fortress near the entrance believed to have been Hatim's palace.

In the village center, visitors can explore the ruins of an ancient mud palace and a small cemetery with two unusually long graves—one of which, stretching 9.5 meters, is believed by locals to be the resting place of Hatim Al-Ta’i, while the other is thought to belong to his daughter, who is said to have witnessed the dawn of Islam.

Visit Al Adham, nestled amidst stunning mountains and a uniquely serene landscape, immerse yourself in the enchanting "Qumra" event, a celebration of Saudi heritage with captivating Samri performances.
Held for three nights each Hijri month (14th, 15th, and 16th, excluding Ramadan), this event fills the air with traditional melodies in a vibrant setting under the refreshing evening breeze.
Don't miss the spectacular horse shows featuring skilled riders, both men and women, showcasing their artistry and mastery.
These breathtaking displays take place during the first three days of each Gregorian month.
Discover Al Samra Mountain, a part of the Shammar Mountains located east of Hail, steeped in history and captivating tales.
History reveals that Hatim Al-Tai lit a fire on its summit, known as "Al Mawqida," to guide travelers and passersby to his home.
Today, Al Samra Mountain features breathtaking views, a scenic overlook, and an Italian restaurant and cafe offering a unique dining experience.
Whether you're exploring its historic legacy or enjoying its serene atmosphere, Al Samra Mountain is a destination that beautifully blends heritage and modern leisure.
You cannot learn the history of a region without visiting its museums and historical sites, as museums represent a wonderful means of showcasing heritage and transferring it to future generations.
During your visit to the Qassim region, you may find a great opportunity to learn about the region's heritage and culture by visiting the Al-Oqilat Museum.
King Khalid Park in Buraidah is a destination for relaxation. Its lush green spaces and shady trees are in a vast area designed to accommodate family and friend gatherings.
It offers a joyful outdoor atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
A tourist landmark where visitors can learn about the cultural, social, and industrial heritage of the region.
The fragrant smell of perfumes fills the alleys of the historic Mithnab Village, introducing visitors to the authentic heritage of Qassim Province.
The village clings to its extreme authenticity, as the traditional mud houses welcome you with their ancient construction and lanterns hanging on their walls.
The old inhabitants of the province narrate the history of Qassim, as their memories are filled with stories and tales that they preserve with utmost care.
The Shamasiyah Museum is one of the important landmarks in the Shamasiyah governorate, Al-Qassim Province.
It displays a diverse collection of rare historical artifacts and introduces important personalities from the region's intellectuals, thinkers, and leaders.

facts.text_ar: استكشف بيت البسام التراثي، النموذج البارز للعمارة النجدية الواقع قرب البوابة الغربية لمدينة عنيزة.
facts.text_en: Explore Al Bassam Heritage House, a remarkable example of Najdi architecture located near the western gate of Unayzah city.

facts.text_ar: شُيّد بين عامي 1374 و1378هـ، ويمتد على 3,500 م²، ويُظهر براعة العمارة النجدية بتصاميمه الدقيقة وأساساته الحجرية وعناصره من خشب الأثل في الأسقف والأبواب والنوافذ.
facts.text_en: Constructed between 1374 and 1378 AH, this 3,500-square-meter house showcases the architectural ingenuity of Najd with its intricate designs, stone foundations, and tamarisk wood features, including ceilings, doors, and windows.

facts.text_ar: يتكوّن البيت من أربعة أقسام: مجلس الرجال، وقسم العائلة، والحديقة، وحظائر الحيوانات.
facts.text_en: The house consists of four distinct sections: the men’s reception area, a family section, a garden, and animal pens.

facts.text_ar: يمكن للزوار استكشاف المجلس والفناء المفتوح وقاعة الطعام، وكل مساحة منها تعكس التراث الثقافي والمعماري للمنطقة.
facts.text_en: Visitors can also explore the majlis, an open yard, and a dining hall, each space echoing the region’s cultural and architectural heritage.

facts.text_ar: بيت تقليدي يقع في محافظة عنيزة بمنطقة القصيم وسط المملكة العربية السعودية.
facts.text_en: A traditional house in Unaizah governorate, Qassim region, in central Saudi Arabia.

facts.text_ar: يقع قرب البوابة الغربية للبلدة القديمة المسماة «باب الخلا» بجوار سوق المسوكف الشعبي، وتبلغ مساحته نحو 3,500 م².
facts.text_en: It stands near the old city's western gate, 'Bab Al-Khala', beside the Al-Musawkaf popular market, over an area of about 3,500 m².

description_ar: بيت طيني تقليدي في محافظة عنيزة بمنطقة القصيم، يقع قرب البوابة الغربية للبلدة القديمة المسماة «باب الخلا» بجوار سوق المسوكف الشعبي، وتبلغ مساحته نحو 3,500 م².
description_en: A traditional mud-brick house in Unaizah governorate, Qassim, beside the old town's western gate known as 'Bab Al-Khala' and next to the Al-Musawkaf market, covering about 3,500 m².
era_ar: عمارة نجدية تقليدية في عنيزة
era_en: Traditional Najdi architecture in Unaizah

visit_info.note_ar: بيت تراثي مُرمّم يُزار ضمن جولة البلدة القديمة في عنيزة.
visit_info.note_en: A restored heritage house visited as part of the old town route in Unaizah.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: Enjoy your time in a distinctive destination that combines authenticity with the serene charm of a wintry atmosphere.

The promenade winds through historic palm farms with over 700 palm trees, some of which are more than 100 years old, showcasing the agricultural heritage of the region in a setting that offers tranquillity and a connection to nature.
It’s the perfect spot for a stroll among the palms or a relaxing meal at one of the many restaurants and cafes, offering diverse options to suit all tastes.

The Palms Avenue isn’t just a place to visit; it’s a moment to pause, reflect, and enjoy the seamless blend of heritage and nature, making it a favourite for families and seekers of unique experiences.
Maqsourat Al-Rajhi is a stunning collection of mud houses located amid palm plantations in the southeastern part of Bukayriyah province.
Built over 250 years ago by Sheikh Nasser Al-Rajhi, this historical site exemplifies the craftsmanship of Najdi architecture.
The site includes a traditional mosque and an ancient well, where the historic Swani irrigation method was used to draw water.
Recently restored to closely resemble its original form, Maqsourat Al-Rajhi served as a welcoming haven for travelers and guests.
Maqsourat Al-Swailim is one of the most iconic heritage landmarks in Bukayriyah, blending the charm of the past with modern refinement.

Built by the former Prince of Bukayriyah, Abdullah bin Swailim bin Othman Al-Swailim, shortly after the province's establishment, this grand palace stands as a testament to the cultural richness of Najdi heritage.
The palace includes several facilities that highlight the architectural brilliance of the era.
Preserved with exceptional care, Maqsourat Al-Swailim maintains its beauty and historic integrity.
Asib Avenue offers a unique escape in the vibrant city of Buraydah, combining modern amenities with a touch of natural charm.
The avenue features a range of cafes, bakeries, and tea brands, along with exceptional restaurants serving diverse and delicious cuisines.
It’s also home to boutique shops perfect for shopping enthusiasts. For entertainment, visitors can enjoy an activity zone with games like archery and darts, providing fun for all ages.
Aseeb Avenue in Buraydah is the perfect spot for great food, exciting activities, and memorable moments with family and friends.
Jazan Province is known for its varied heritage. Near the southern corniche of Jazan City, a tourist attraction, established in 1439 Hijri, showcases the ancient history of the region.

It is a fine combination of archeological buildings, handicrafts, popular food restaurants, cultural programs, modern arts, and national festivals, which makes the Heritage Village of Jazan an engaging cultural landmark and tourist destination for all society groups

The historic Al Dosariyah Castle is located on a mountain overlooking the port of Jazan. It was built in 1933 for military purposes, and its elevated location provides a clear aerial view of the port and the horizon.

The castle was built with a military character and defensive systems such as protection walls installed at the entrances, an observation room on the upper floor, and openings in the walls for observation and shooting.

facts.text_ar: تتميز جبال فيفاء، أو ما يُطلق عليها «جارة القمر»، بإطلالتها الساحرة على ارتفاع يتجاوز 1,800 متر فوق مستوى سطح البحر.
facts.text_en: The Fifa Mountains, or as they are called "Neighbor of the Moon", are distinguished by their enchanting view, at an altitude of more than 1,800 km above sea level.

facts.text_ar: هي سلسلة جبال ملتفّة حول بعضها، تكسو الخضرة قممها، ومنها: اللغة، والكدرة، وباقة الوشل، والسرّة، وقردة، والسماء.
facts.text_en: They are a series of mountains wrapped around one another, with peaks covered with green, including: Al-Lagha, Al-Kadrah, Baqat Al-Washl, Al-Surrah, Qardah, and Al-Sama'.

facts.text_ar: أعلاها قمة العبسية، وتبعد جبال فيفاء نحو 100 كم عن مدينة جازان، ويتسم مناخها بالاعتدال معظم أيام السنة.
facts.text_en: The highest one is Al-Absiyya summit. The Fifa Mountains are about 100 km from the city of Jazan, and the climate there is moderately characterized most of the year.

facts.text_ar: وفي الشتاء يميل الجو إلى البرودة في المرتفعات، بدرجات حرارة تتراوح تقريبًا بين 19 و29 درجة مئوية.
facts.text_en: In winter, it tends to be cold in the high mountains, with a temperature of approximately 19-29 degrees Celsius.

facts.text_ar: فيفاء إحدى محافظات منطقة جازان جنوب غربي المملكة العربية السعودية.
facts.text_en: Fayfa is one of the governorates of the Jazan region in south-western Saudi Arabia.

description_ar: سلسلة جبلية مدرّجة في محافظة فيفاء بمنطقة جازان جنوب غربي المملكة، تشتهر بمدرجاتها الزراعية وضبابها الكثيف وزراعة البن والمانجو.
description_en: A terraced mountain range in Fayfa governorate, Jazan region, in south-western Saudi Arabia, known for its agricultural terraces, dense mist, and coffee and mango cultivation.
era_ar: مشهد زراعي جبلي تقليدي متوارث
era_en: A traditional inherited mountain agricultural landscape

visit_info.note_ar: طرق جبلية حادة الانحدار؛ يُنصح بمركبة مناسبة وقيادة نهارية.
visit_info.note_en: Steep mountain roads; a suitable vehicle and daytime driving are advised.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, Jazan coast is a starting point for adventurous diving excursions and cruises, which promise you a great vacation.
Dream Divers is the way to have this fun, as it plans swimming and diving courses and excursions, under the supervision of diving experts and swimming coaches.
It also has a marketplace for diving and sailing equipment.

facts.text_ar: يقع جامع محمد بن عبدالوهاب في حي البجيري بالدرعية، بتصميم منسجم مع الطراز المعماري للمنطقة.
facts.text_en: Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Wahhab Mosque is located in Al-Bujairi district in Diriyah, with a design that is consistent with the architectural style of the region.

facts.text_ar: تحيط به مساحات مزيّنة بمسطحات خضراء وأشجار نخيل ومصاطب حجرية.
facts.text_en: It is surrounded by spaces decorated with green landscapes, palm trees, and stone terraces.

facts.text_ar: يقع الجامع في حي البجيري وهو أحد مساجد الطين في مدينة الدرعية التراثية.
facts.text_en: The mosque stands in the Al-Bujairi district and is one of the mud-brick mosques of heritage Diriyah.

facts.text_ar: يُعد الجامع مقرًا لمؤسسة الشيخ محمد بن عبدالوهاب الثقافية.
facts.text_en: It serves as the seat of the Sheikh Mohammad bin Abdul Wahhab Cultural Foundation.

description_ar: أحد مساجد الطين في الدرعية التاريخية، يقع في حي البجيري، ويُعد اليوم مقرًا لمؤسسة الشيخ محمد بن عبدالوهاب الثقافية.
description_en: One of the mud-brick mosques of historic Diriyah, located in the Al-Bujairi district, and today the seat of the Sheikh Mohammad bin Abdul Wahhab Cultural Foundation.
era_ar: القرن 12هـ/18م — عصر الدولة السعودية الأولى
era_en: 18th century CE — First Saudi State

visit_info.note_ar: يقع ضمن حي البجيري المطوَّر المفتوح للزوار مقابل حي الطريف.
visit_info.note_en: Located inside the redeveloped Al-Bujairi district, open to visitors opposite At-Turaif.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: In the western side of Diriyah, Wadi Safar Dam is located on a 60-square meter area. It is an extension of Wadi Hanifa.

The location is characterized by its rural nature, and contains rock seating areas with wonderful views and a nice ambience, giving you the opportunity for a special picnic with family and friends in the weekend, surrounded by warm cups of tea, along with the aromas of barbecues.

facts.text_ar: قصور ومساجد ومنازل طينية مذهلة تشكّل هذا الموقع المدرج في قائمة التراث العالمي لليونسكو، وقد رُمّم الحي بعناية ليستعيد رونقه السابق.
facts.text_en: Stunning mud-brick palaces, mosques, and homes make up this UNESCO World Heritage site. Today, the district has been carefully restored to its former glory.

facts.text_ar: تروي المتاحف قصة أوائل المستوطنين في هذه المنطقة، وتُبرز تاريخ الدولة السعودية، وتتعمّق في العمارة النجدية والإسلامية الفريدة.
facts.text_en: Museums tell the story of the earliest settlers to this region, highlight the history of the Saudi state, and delve into the unique Najdi and Islamic architecture.

facts.text_ar: أُدرج حي الطريف في قائمة التراث العالمي لليونسكو عام 2010م وفق المعايير (iv) و(v) و(vi).
facts.text_en: At-Turaif was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2010 under criteria (iv), (v) and (vi).
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

facts.text_ar: تبلغ مساحة الممتلك المسجّل 28.78 هكتارًا، وتحيط به منطقة عازلة مساحتها 237.95 هكتارًا.
facts.text_en: The inscribed property covers 28.78 ha, surrounded by a buffer zone of 237.95 ha.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

facts.text_ar: وصفته اليونسكو بأنه مجمّع حضري محصّن داخل واحة، ومثال بارز على الأسلوب المعماري والزخرفي النجدي المتكيّف مع بيئته باستخدام الطين في القصور الكبرى.
facts.text_en: UNESCO describes it as a fortified urban ensemble within an oasis and an outstanding example of the Najdi architectural and decorative style, adapted to its environment through the use of adobe in major palatial complexes.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

facts.text_ar: كان الطريف أول مركز تاريخي ذي سلطة موحِّدة في شبه الجزيرة العربية، ومنه انتشرت دعوة الشيخ محمد بن عبدالوهاب بعد تحالفه مع الدولة السعودية في منتصف القرن الثامن عشر.
facts.text_en: At-Turaif was the first historic centre with a unifying power in the Arabian Peninsula; from it the message of Sheikh Mohammad bin Abdul Wahhab spread after his alliance with the Saudi state in the mid-18th century.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

facts.text_ar: الموقع محمي بنظام الآثار رقم م/26 لعام 1392هـ/1972م منذ عام 1976م.
facts.text_en: The site has been protected under Antiquities Act 26M of 1392 AH / 1972 CE since 1976.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

description_ar: أول عاصمة للدولة السعودية الأولى على ضفاف وادي حنيفة، أُسّس في القرن الخامس عشر الميلادي، ويُعد أبرز نموذج للعمارة النجدية الطينية. أُدرج في قائمة التراث العالمي لليونسكو عام 2010م.
description_en: The first capital of the Saudi state, on the edge of Wadi Hanifah, founded in the 15th century and the foremost example of Najdi mud-brick architecture. Inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2010.
era_ar: القرن 15م تأسيسًا — ذروة سياسية في القرنين 18 و19م
era_en: Founded 15th century CE — political peak in the 18th–19th centuries

visit_info.note_ar: موقع أثري مُدار من هيئة تطوير بوابة الدرعية مع مسارات زيارة ومتاحف؛ التذاكر تُحجز عادةً مسبقًا.
visit_info.note_en: An archaeological site managed by the Diriyah Gate Development Authority with visitor routes and museums; tickets are normally booked in advance.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: From the heart of Diriyah, with its rich history that accompanied the stages of founding and unifying the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the Saudi flag rises on the flagpole of King Salman Square.
This flagpole is considered the tallest flagpole in the capital city of Riyadh.
Samhan Farm is 230 Kilometers away from Wadi Hanifah; it combines between the ancient past and modern present, it has beautiful green areas and lots of trees.
JAX District has successfully transformed the industrial heritage site in Diriyah, Saudi Arabia, into a vibrant hub for artists and creatives.

What was once known for its unique mud-brick architecture has now been reborn as the creative hub of the Saudi capital, beckoning talents to showcase their work amidst a supportive and thriving artistic community.

facts.text_ar: منتزه البجيري التراثي السياحي واحة غنّاء تحيط بها أشجار النخيل، ويضم مسطحات خضراء واسعة ومعالم طبيعية كالنباتات والبحيرات والمرتفعات، تتيح لك لحظات من الهدوء والسكينة.
facts.text_en: Al-Bujairi Heritage and Tourism Park is a lush oasis surrounded by palm trees, which includes great green landscapes, and natural landmarks such as plants, lakes, and heights, enabling you to enjoy moments of peace and tranquillity.

facts.text_ar: يقع الحي على الجهة الشرقية لوادي حنيفة مقابلًا لحي الطريف.
facts.text_en: The district lies on the eastern side of Wadi Hanifah, facing At-Turaif.

facts.text_ar: كان الحي سكنًا للشيخ محمد بن عبدالوهاب وأسرته إضافة إلى طلبة العلم.
facts.text_en: It was the residence of Sheikh Mohammad bin Abdul Wahhab and his family, as well as students of knowledge.

description_ar: حي تاريخي على الضفة الشرقية لوادي حنيفة مقابل حي الطريف، كان سكنًا للشيخ محمد بن عبدالوهاب وأسرته وطلبة العلم، وأُعيد تطويره كوجهة ثقافية وسياحية.
description_en: A historic district on the eastern bank of Wadi Hanifah facing At-Turaif, once home to Sheikh Mohammad bin Abdul Wahhab, his family and students of knowledge, now redeveloped as a cultural and tourism destination.
era_ar: القرن 18م، مع تطوير حديث
era_en: 18th century CE, with modern redevelopment

visit_info.note_ar: وجهة مفتوحة تضم مطاعم ومساحات ثقافية وإطلالة على حي الطريف.
visit_info.note_en: An open destination with restaurants, cultural venues and views over At-Turaif.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_ar: بطول 120 كم، يمتد وادي حنيفة من مرتفعات الحيسية شمالًا حتى الحاير جنوبي الرياض.
facts.text_en: With a length of 120 km, Wadi Hanifa extends from the heights of Al-Haisiyah in the North to Al-Hayer in Southern Riyadh.

facts.text_ar: ضمن هذه المساحة الواسعة يمكنك وضع عشرات الخطط للاستمتاع بجمال الطبيعة، وتتوفر مرافق ترفيهية على جانبي قناة مياه وادي حنيفة الممتدة 57 كم.
facts.text_en: Within this vast area, you can make dozens of plans to enjoy the beauty of nature. Recreation facilities are available on both sides of the 57-km-long Wadi Hanifa water channel.

facts.text_ar: أُعيد تأهيل وادي حنيفة بصورة فريدة، وتزيّن ضفافه حدائق بمرافق وخدمات متكاملة تتيح للزوار الاستمتاع بالمسطحات الخضراء في أجواء مبهجة في الهواء الطلق.
facts.text_en: You are going to enjoy this trip to its fullest! Wadi Hanifa is uniquely redeveloped. Its banks are adorned with parks with complete facilities and services to allow visitors to enjoy the green landscapes in a joyful atmosphere in the open air.

facts.text_ar: بُنيت الدرعية، أول عاصمة للدولة السعودية، على حافة واحة الدرعية في وادي حنيفة، ولا تزال آثار مجمّعها الحضري قائمة على ضفافه.
facts.text_en: Diriyah, the first capital of the Saudi state, was built on the edge of the ad-Dir'iyah oasis in Wadi Hanifah, and the remains of its urban ensemble still stand along the valley.
facts.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah

description_ar: أشهر أودية نجد، يمتد نحو 120 كم عبر الرياض والدرعية، وعلى ضفافه نشأت الدرعية عاصمة الدولة السعودية الأولى، وقد أُعيد تأهيله بيئيًا كمتنزه خطي.
description_en: The most famous valley of Najd, running some 120 km through Riyadh and Diriyah. Diriyah, capital of the First Saudi State, grew on its banks; the valley has been environmentally rehabilitated as a linear park.
era_ar: موقع استيطان متصل عبر عصور تاريخية متعددة
era_en: A site of continuous settlement across multiple historical periods

visit_info.note_ar: متنزه عام مفتوح على مدار العام مع مسارات مشي وبحيرات معالجة.
visit_info.note_en: A public park open year-round with walking trails and treated water pools.
visit_info.disclaimer_ar: مواعيد العمل والتذاكر تتغير؛ يرجى التأكد من المصدر الرسمي قبل الزيارة.
visit_info.disclaimer_en: Opening hours and ticketing change; confirm with the official source before visiting.

facts.text_en: Revive your energy with friends in the Mondial Courts in Diriyah and enjoy many games that come at the top of the list of the most important sports around the world, such as football, tennis, and many other sports.
You can enjoy these sports in 15 courts equipped with appropriate lighting and searchlights to continue playing any time throughout the week between 04:00 PM until 02:00 AM.

You will find many international and local restaurants and shops in Albujairi Terrace. On an area of ​​15,000 m2, Albujairi has intricate details inspired by the authenticity of Najd and its history full of amazing architecture, and has amazing views on the historical At-Turaif district, which is included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.
You can enjoy scenic natural views in a group picnic, or even alone in the designated bike lanes in the terrace.
Or you can walk in the paths that trace the Kingdom’s history and its stories when Diriyah was the capital of the first Saudi state.
In the calmness of nature away from the crowded city, you will find Sofie Farm, one of the best rural experiences that is available all week long, from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm.
Diriyah Terrace is an open space that includes several local and international restaurants and cafes and seating areas surrounded by tall palm trees.
The terrace is fragrant with the aroma of authentic Saudi coffee in a captivating night that gathers loved ones around a winter table in which American and Italian cuisines are present.
You can enjoy all of this with an open view of the sky, in the midst of bright golden lights and the melodies of music that fill the place.
In Diriyah Terrace, modern landmarks and historical glories embrace each other in one place.
Day or night, you can visit the Diriyah Walk to relieve the burdens of a long day, or to ignite your imagination with a flow of inspiring ideas.
Have a walk amid the cool breeze and the rustling of lush palm trees of Diriyah in safe and paved spaces.
Ghasiba district, located on the banks of Wadi Hanifa, is the core from which Diriyah was founded, and represents the beginning of its long history which exceeds 600 years.
With a storage capacity of 900 thousand m3 and a length of 170 meters, learn about the 50-year old Ghubaira Dam, one of the side dams of Wadi Hanifa in the new Diriyah.

facts.text_ar: قصر سلوى معلم تاريخي يختزل حقبة محورية في تاريخ المملكة، إذ يقف كنافذة تعود بك إلى زمن تأسيس الدولة السعودية الأولى.
facts.text_en: Salwa Palace is a historical landmark that encapsulates a crucial time in the history of the Kingdom, for it stands as a window with a view that takes you back in time to the establishment of the First Saudi State.

facts.text_ar: يتيح فرصة لاكتشاف عمارة عمرها قرون، وقد سُمّي بهذا الاسم لتعدد استخدامات بنائه بما جعله سلوى لساكنيه وزائريه.
facts.text_en: It offers a chance to discover centuries-old architecture. It was given this name because its construction has multiple uses, making it a consolation for its residents and visitors.

facts.text_ar: يشغل القصر مساحة نحو عشرة آلاف متر مربع في الجزء الشرقي من حي الطريف، وهو من أكبر القصور التاريخية في المملكة.
facts.text_en: The palace occupies about 10,000 m² in the eastern part of At-Turaif and is among the largest historic palaces in the Kingdom.

facts.text_ar: بُني على مراحل ويتكون من سبع وحدات ضمّت مجالس الاستقبال والضيافة وسكن الإمام وأسرته ومكاتب إدارات الدولة، وأُضيف إليه مسجد.
facts.text_en: It was built in phases and comprises seven units housing reception and guest halls, the Imam's residence and family quarters, state administrative offices, and an added mosque.

facts.text_ar: هُجر القصر عام 1233هـ/1818م إثر تدمير الدرعية عاصمة الدولة السعودية الأولى.
facts.text_en: The palace was abandoned in 1233 AH / 1818 CE after the destruction of Diriyah, capital of the First Saudi State.

description_ar: قصر الحكم في عهد الدولة السعودية الأولى، ومن أكبر القصور التاريخية في المملكة، يقع في الجزء الشرقي من حي الطريف بالدرعية ويشغل نحو عشرة آلاف متر مربع.
description_en: The seat of government of the First Saudi State and one of the largest historic palaces in the Kingdom, occupying about 10,000 m² in the eastern part of At-Turaif in Diriyah.
era_ar: القرن 18م حتى 1233هـ/1818م
era_en: 18th century CE until 1233 AH / 1818 CE

facts.text_en: Explore an 18th-century palace when you visit Diriyah Museum. Make your way through galleries to learn about the complete history of the region.
Discover the story of the House of Saud, the nation’s royal family, as well as the tribe that lived in the region before Diriyah was settled in 1446.
The palace itself is a stunning example of the region’s Najdi architecture.
Get a glimpse of what life was like for people living in the first Saudi state at this museum.
Housed in a historic palace, the Social Life Museum features recreations of guest rooms, servants' quarters, and meeting halls that were found in historic homes.
An audio guide walks visitors through each gallery, while artifacts on display include traditional clothing, furniture, tools, and cookware.
